# krds-react global design tokens (v1.1.1)

These are the `:root`-scoped custom properties from `node_modules/krds-react/dist/index.css` — the actual color/typography/spacing values behind every component. Prefer a krds-react component over hand-rolling styles from these tokens (see SKILL.md), but when you must style custom markup (a page background, a section that has no matching component) to look KRDS-native, pull the color/spacing from here rather than guessing a hex value or Tailwind default.

There are ~1800 tokens total; this file lists the global/semantic ones. Component-scoped tokens (e.g. `--krds-badge--color-primary-text`) live directly in each component's CSS and are enumerated in `component-catalog.md` implicitly — style via the component's own props instead of overriding those.
